sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Use this example as the model for the guided set below.

items.prompt: Write the equation, in slope-intercept form, of a line with slope -2 and y-intercept 5.

steps: Slope-intercept form is y = mx + b.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: Identify the slope and y-intercept of the line y = -5x.

Relationship A: y = 3x
Relationship B (proportional):
x: 1, 2, 3
y: 6, 12, 18
Which relationship has the greater rate of change (unit rate)?
choices: They have the same rate of change.
The rate of change cannot be determined from this information.

items.prompt: For the line y = (2/3)x + 6, find y when x = 12.
A line has equation y = (-9/2)x + 9. Which of these equations represents a line parallel to it?
A line has equation y = (-1/4)x + 13. Write the equation of the line through (-24, -4) that is parallel to this line.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A moving company's total cost is given by C = 8h + 13, where C is the total cost in dollars and h is the number of hours of labor. What does the slope represent in this context?
choices: The company charges a flat fee of $13 before any labor hours.
The company charges $13 for each additional hour of labor.
The company charges a flat fee of $8 before any labor hours.
The company charges $8 for each additional hour of labor.

items.prompt: The amount of water in a tank is given by G = 10t + 11, where G is the number of gallons in the tank and t is the number of minutes since filling started. What does the y-intercept represent in this context?
choices: The tank already had 11 gallons of water before filling started.
The tank already had 10 gallons of water before filling started.
The tank fills at a rate of 11 gallons per minute.
The tank fills at a rate of 10 gallons per minute.

items.prompt: Find the slope of the line through (1, 12) and (-17, -8).

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt:
A line passes through these points:
x: -15, -12, -9
y: 5, 13, 21
What is the slope (rate of change) of the line?

A line passes through (8, -11). A slope triangle on the line has a horizontal leg (run) of 5 and a vertical leg (rise) of 1. A similar slope triangle further along the same line is 4 times as large. Which point also lies on the line?
